title_zh: 成龙：把功夫带到世界的电影明星
title_en: Famous Chinese People (9/20): Jackie Chan, the Star Who Took Kung Fu to the World
note_en: 差点 (chàdiǎn) or 差一点 means "almost, nearly" and usually marks a narrow escape: 差点受重伤 "was nearly badly hurt," 差一点就失去了生命 "very nearly lost his life." Where English needs a separate adverb, Chinese simply puts 差(一)点 before the verb, and adding 就 makes the near miss sound even closer.
